title: Endless Summer | KEY.co
description_expanded: Pet-friendly and ideally situated close to the beach, this retreat offers everything needed for a relaxing getaway. With a large living area featuring a queen sleeper sofa a 65" TV, and a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, the home is designed for both entertainment and comfort. The master bedroom boasts a king bed and a 55" TV, while the second bedroom offers a queen bed and a 40" 4K Smart TV. The third bedroom, equipped with a full-over-full bunk bed and a 40" TV, makes it perfect for families or groups. Experience the luxury of modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi, full-size washer/dryer, and streaming services via YouTube on all TVs. The 17-mile bike path encourages exploration, whether on foot or by bike, offering endless opportunities to enjoy the stunning surroundings. This townhome sleeps up to ten guests, making it ideal for family vacations or group trips. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to ensure a memorable and enjoyable stay in this charming coastal haven.
